recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic 1960s-style composition featuring two male portraits framed within a large, lime-green organic 'blob' shape, surrounded by flowing, multi-colored psychedelic ribbons and bold, hand-lettered display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Portraits nested within a primary organic shape
Typography following the curvature of graphic elements
Vibrant color bands acting as directional vectors
High-contrast interplay between flat graphic areas and photographic realism

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male portraits occupy the center-left and center-right, scaled to fill the lower two-thirds of the central green shape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large lime-green organic shape serves as the primary container for the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-right typography, follows the purple ribbon curve down to the portraits, and exits via the orange and blue stripes on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant off-white space on the right and bottom edges provides breathing room for the dense central graphics.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright sky blue and Lemon yellow (text/ribbons)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements contrasted against natural skin tones and a muted background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with irregular, bouncy baselines
Variable stroke thickness suggesting brush or marker application
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and U characters are exaggeratedly wide and circular
Ascenders and descenders are shortened to fit tight curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, bouncy sans-serif for names paired with a fluid, connected script for secondary titles.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the soft, heavy, 60s sans-serif feel
Matches the fluid, thick-stroke script elements

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with a textured off-white background. Place a large, lime-green organic blob shape in the center. Inside the blob, place two realistic portraits of men from the 1960s. Add flowing ribbons of purple, orange, and blue that curve around the top and right side of the green shape. Include a small maroon teardrop shape in the bottom left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in yellow and white. The text should follow the curve of the purple ribbon at the top. Use a heavy, bouncy, rounded sans-serif for the main names and a fluid script for the subtitle. Add a small list of text in a simple yellow sans-serif inside the maroon teardrop.

verificationChecks: Text follows the organic curves of the graphic elements
Portraits are contained within the green shape
Color palette is limited to the specified 60s tones
Background has a subtle paper texture

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the lime green
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the curves
Check that the portraits don't overlap the outer ribbons
Verify the 'bouncy' rhythm of the lettering
Confirm the off-white background has a vintage paper feel
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Organic Shape Container] + [Flowing Multi-color Ribbons] + [Bouncy Hand-Lettering] + [Realistic Portraits] for a 1960s soul aesthetic.
